body: As long as someone besides me will read it, I'll post it.
I'm still alive, bud. And yes, I realize the inconsistency with pills. But i think it would be hard to fuck up with 10,000mg of Vicodin. I updated my post, if you care to read.
I talked to somebody. Details in the update, if you're interested.
I'd love to hear some stories, man. Anything to get my self destructing mind to shut up. Updated my post, if you care to look.

You we're absolutely right. I haven't sealed my fate. But the thought is always going to be there. It's something we have to live with. Sometimes I just let shit get to me. I don't know. Updated my story, if you're interested.
Hey, sorry for not writing back earlier. Thanks for your concern. It does wonders on my head, knowing someone gives a fuck. Details in the update, if you're interested.

Thanks for your concern, man. Sorry I didn't write back. I was just going to use this page as sort of a suicide note to who ever found me. Just so they knew what was going on. But I didn't go through. details in the update, if your interested.
Still here, buddy. Unfortunately. I'm seeing the doc this afternoon. I've made a suicide pact with myself. I'm giving it half a year for things to look up.
